note: Known app bugs (documentation/development/agentic_scenario_testing.md, section 6). A check marked known K<n> is an expected failure (xfail); when it passes it is reported as xpass, 'fixed? K<n>'. invariant_waivers turn an invariant's failures into expected failures in every scenario; remove a waiver when its bug is fixed.

bugs.K1: A tool batch is not one undo step
bugs.K2: Tool results say 'Call successful!' when nothing happened
bugs.K3: Requested names are silently replaced and the replacement is not reported
bugs.K4: Undo only snapshots drawables (not the view)
bugs.K5: Workspace round-trips lose colours, custom angle names and grid visibility
bugs.K6: Deletes cascade into objects that only share parts
bugs.K7: delete_vector recurses forever when a segment has the same endpoints
bugs.K8: A cached circle formula goes stale when the centre moves through another object
bugs.K9: create_circle_arc moves existing points onto the circle
bugs.K10: create_colored_area and create_region_colored_area reject color: null
bugs.K11: Translating a function leaves its asymptotes behind
bugs.K12: draw_function on an existing name skips re-analysis; draw_function never validates bounds
bugs.K13: No guard for a tangent at a vertical asymptote
bugs.K14: Coloured-area bounds do not follow a translated function
bugs.K15: An area between two segments adds points and splits segments
bugs.K16: Polygon type flags are computed only in the constructor
bugs.K17: Cached angle values are never refreshed
bugs.K18: Graph bugs: adjacency-matrix edges always directed; delete_graph deletes reused points
bugs.K19: Polygon subtypes move and re-order the given vertices
bugs.K20: Action-trace state_delta is always empty (fixed with the scenario hooks)
bugs.K21: Errors returned as {"error": ...} dicts are not flagged as errors
bugs.K22: The CLI's canvas commands do nothing (fixed with the scenario hooks)
bugs.K23: The workspace load URL is not encoded
bugs.K24: A removable discontinuity is reported as a vertical asymptote
bugs.K25: Canvas.reset does not reset the polar grid spacing (slow polar rendering after zoom then clear)
